# fjordrun_project (Data Source)

A project, by `id`, or by `team_id` and `name`. `environment_ids` finds its environments by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "team_id" {
  type = string
}

data "fjordrun_project" "shop" {
  team_id = var.team_id
  name    = "shop"
}

output "staging_environment_id" {
  value = data.fjordrun_project.shop.environment_ids["staging"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Project ID. Set this, or `team_id` and `name`.
- `name` (String) Project name, with `team_id`.
- `team_id` (String) Team ID, with `name`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `default_environment_id` (String) The environment API calls use when they name none.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `environment_ids` (Map of String) Environment IDs by name.
- `environments` (Attributes List) The project's environments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments))
- `icon` (String) Icon.
- `region` (String) `nbg1`, `fsn1` or `hel1`.
- `service_count` (Number) Number of services.
- `updated_at` (String) Last change.

<a id="nestedatt--environments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environments`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `id` (String) Environment ID.
- `is_ephemeral` (Boolean) Whether it is a short-lived preview environment.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID.
- `slug` (String) URL-safe name.
